description: The identity fixture. A match no matcher could have produced -- it selects fr with type CLDR_FALLBACK at effective weight 0.25 while naming de, which is not loaded, as its only requested range -- over a catalog engineered so every failure reason is reachable: Missing.Everywhere is absent from both locales, NoMatch.Alternatives is an alternatives-only root whose predicate is false for the counts these cases pass, and Res.Failure declares only CARDINALITY_ONE. Section 8.3 requires the SAME match object through the result and failure paths; every existing observation of that in the corpus comes from a matcher-derived match, so this asserts it for a supplied one.

NoMatch.Alternatives.commentary: Alternatives-only root with no default translation, so a predicate miss is NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE rather than MISSING_TRANSLATION.

Res.Failure.commentary: Only CARDINALITY_ONE is declared, so any count French classifies as OTHER throws inside resolution and getResult classifies the attempt as RESOLUTION_FAILURE.

NoMatch.Alternatives.commentary: The fallback candidate misses the same way, so the walk ends in a failure rather than resolving.

Res.Failure.commentary: The fallback candidate is under-declared the same way, so a permissive policy still ends in a failure.
